foreach ($relativePath in $files.Keys) {
  $fullPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
  $directory = Split-Path -Parent $fullPath
  if (!(Test-Path $directory)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force | Out-Null }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($fullPath, [Convert]::FromBase64String($files[$relativePath]))
  Write-Host "Updated $relativePath"
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Mother Soil Equipments website files updated successfully." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Run: npm install" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Then: npm run dev" -ForegroundColor Cyan
